# Machine access

Service accounts, their API keys, and the SCIM tokens for directory sync.

## service-accounts

### `GET /api/service-accounts`

List the org's service accounts. Org-admin-only.

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ServiceAccountListResponse`](schemas.md#serviceaccountlistresponse) | Service accounts |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Org admin required |

### `POST /api/service-accounts`

Create a service account (a machine principal + its org membership).
Org-admin-only.

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateServiceAccountRequest`](schemas.md#createserviceaccountrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`ServiceAccountView`](schemas.md#serviceaccountview) | Service account created |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Org admin required |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Empty name |

### `DELETE /api/service-accounts/{id}`

Delete a service account and all its keys. Org-admin-only. Unknown id → 404.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Service account id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`DeletedResponse`](schemas.md#deletedresponse) | Deleted |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Org admin required |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Unknown service account |

### `GET /api/service-accounts/{id}/keys`

List a service account's keys (metadata only). Org-admin-only.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Service account id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ApiKeyListResponse`](schemas.md#apikeylistresponse) | Key metadata (never secrets) |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Org admin required |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Unknown service account |

### `POST /api/service-accounts/{id}/keys`

Mint an API key for a service account: return the secret ONCE, store only
its hash. Org-admin-only. Unknown service account → 404.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Service account id (UUID) |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateApiKeyRequest`](schemas.md#createapikeyrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`ApiKeyCreatedResponse`](schemas.md#apikeycreatedresponse) | Key minted; secret shown once |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Org admin required |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Unknown service account |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Empty name or bad expiry |

### `DELETE /api/service-accounts/{id}/keys/{key_id}`

Revoke a key (soft: `revoked_at` set). Org-admin-only. Unknown ids → 404;
already revoked → 409.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Service account id (UUID) |
| `key_id` | path | yes | `string` | API key id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`DeletedResponse`](schemas.md#deletedresponse) | Key revoked |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Org admin required |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Unknown service account or key |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Already revoked |

## scim-tokens

### `GET /api/scim-tokens`

List the tenant's SCIM tokens (metadata only). Org-admin-only.

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ScimTokenListResponse`](schemas.md#scimtokenlistresponse) | Token metadata (never secrets) |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Org admin required |

### `POST /api/scim-tokens`

Create a SCIM token: mint the secret, store only its hash, return the
secret ONCE. Org-admin-only.

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateScimTokenRequest`](schemas.md#createscimtokenrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`ScimTokenCreatedResponse`](schemas.md#scimtokencreatedresponse) | Token created; secret shown once |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Org admin required |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Empty name |

### `DELETE /api/scim-tokens/{id}`

Revoke a SCIM token (soft: `revoked_at` set, row retained for audit).
Unknown id → 404; already revoked → 409. Org-admin-only.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | SCIM token id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ScimTokenRevokedResponse`](schemas.md#scimtokenrevokedresponse) | Token revoked |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Org admin required |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Unknown token id |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](schemas.md#errorenvelope) | Already revoked |
